WHAT I DO NOW

Connecting the dots.
For a reason.

At NatWest, I work with complex data from around the world in the financial crime domain.

Through entity resolution and big data engineering, I help connect scattered records into a clearer picture, supporting the work that makes financial systems safer.

I like knowing that the work means something beyond a successful pipeline run.

Finance drew me in because of its real-world impact; technology gave me a way to contribute to it.
